headline: Payments of $1,742,414.66 in outstanding bills, plus updates on Central Falls High School and Raices Dual Language School projects.
summary: A vote on $1,742,414.66 in outstanding bills under Bond Series 2025 Requisition #3. Updates cover the high school, Raices Dual Language School, other projects, apprenticeship efforts, business enterprise efforts, and a revolving fund.
items: Other project updates: Abatement and Demolition, Retaining Wall, Track & Field Replacement
School Building Committee Revolving Fund: 26/27 Revolving Fund Subcommittee update (potential vote)
